How to pay for your trip 
How to pay for your trip 
 September 25, 2026 
Table of contents 
🇨🇦  · Applies to Canada only · Click here for US version 
Paying for your trip on Poparide is quick and easy. We accept several payment methods to ensure a smooth and secure booking process. 
Accepted payment methods 
You can pay for your trip using: 
Credit cards : VISA, Mastercard, and American Express 
VISA Debit and Mastercard Debit cards : These cards work like credit cards for online payments 
Prepaid cards : VISA and Mastercard prepaid cards 
Unfortunately, we don’t accept PayPal, Interac e-transfers, cash, or bank transfers as valid payment methods. 
How payment works 
We will pre-authorize the total amount when you book a seat using your selected payment method. Once the driver confirms your booking, the payment will be processed, and you’ll receive a confirmation of the booking and payment details. 
Payment security 
All payments are processed securely and encrypted to keep your information safe. 
If your payment fails, make sure your card has sufficient funds or check with your card provider to ensure it’s enabled for online payments.
